name: Cola V
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: ½ in. wide strip of lemon peel cut around the fruit's circumference
½ in. wide strip of lemon peel cut around the fruit's circumference
½ in. wide strip of orange peel cut around the fruit's circumference

steps: Boil all of the ingredients except for the vanilla extract and bitters in a pot until it becomes sticky.
Add the vanilla extract and bitters.
To make the finished soda, combine 1 volume of syrup with 5 volumes of carbonated water.

culture.text: }}Cola is a type of soda that consists of flavors derived from citrus fruits and spices. The word "cola" derives from kola nuts, a plant originating in West Africa. Older cola recipes often contained this nut as a source of caffeine, but most modern recipes do not contain kola nuts. This recipe has been modified from one created by Soko's Kitchen.
